verdict.rationale: The buzz-acp harness "listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts your agent, and the agent replies using the Buzz CLI." Each agent gets its own keypair identity, is enrolled via `add-member`, and has "their own channel memberships." The managed-agent skill can also create agents scoped to the current channel, and the remote-agents vision describes steering an agent by mentioning it. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that adding an agent to a channel and mention-triggered replies work in practice (community comments only describe it as "bots in chat rooms").
